correctness.rationale: For a compact antilinearly self-adjoint A, Takagi diagonalization yields nonnegative singular sigma_j. With rho=|q|<1, express each unit constrained pair as x=sqrt(b+)u+sqrt(b-)v and y=sqrt(b+)u-sqrt(b-)v with orthonormal u,v and b±=(1±rho)/2; antilinear symmetry cancels mixed bilinear terms. Weighted Ky Fan yields upper b+sigma1+b-sigma2, and explicit vectors sqrt(b+)e1+i sqrt(b-)e2 and sqrt(b+)e1-i sqrt(b-)e2 attain it; the rho=1 endpoint follows by continuity. A two-dimensional isotropic-vector path yields value zero, connectedness of constrained two-frames fills all radial moduli, and phase invariance fills every angle. The strict sigma2>sigma3 gap forces equality frames into top-two Takagi subspace. Independently checked the extremizer and inner-product conjugations symbolically; finite randomized verifier is supplemental.
